items.title: Index Ventures 联合创始人 Neil Rimer 认为 AI 财富将面临"再分配"
items.summary: Index Ventures 联合创始人 Neil Rimer 表示，围绕 AI 积累的巨额财富将面临"某种形式的再分配"，无论是自愿还是强制。他呼吁科技领袖在推动自愿再分配中发挥主导作用。与此同时，美国慈善捐赠总额虽创新高，但捐赠人数持续下降，而加州正考虑对亿万富翁征收 5% 的一次性财富税。

items.text: This post is key. The cheaper AI gets, the more opportunity there is for the entire ecosystem - especially including end-customers - to benefit. Everything is bottlenecked by being able to successfully and cost effectively deploy AI in real workloads. Any time we can lower the co
items.textZh: 进入 AI agent 时代，核心问题来了：当你和竞争对手用的是同一批 AI 模型，竞争优势从哪来？那些能把内部积累的知识、数据资产和行业特定工作流真正接入 AI 的公司，才能保持领先。自建技术栈还是用最好的外部工具，是一个关键变量。但核心是：企业必须找到方式，长期守住自己独特数据、流程和专业经验所创造的价值。我们在 Box 越来越清楚地看到这一点——客户希望把机构知识发挥出来，同时保留随时接入任意 AI 模型的灵活性。这会成为未来企业战略的核心原则。

podcast.name: The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck
podcast.title: OpenAI’s Compute Chief: We Can’t Build Fast Enough | Sachin Katti

zh.lead: 最光鲜的故事，是一个拥有 9750 亿参数的新模型。真正能卖钱的故事，却是一条只有 5 条评论的抱怨：Fable credits became 150 times more expensive（Fable 点数贵了 150 倍），客户是在用量成本变得无法承受后才发现变化。对小团队来说，一次悄无声息的调价，造成的伤害可能比一次基准测试胜利带来的帮助更快。

build.title: PriceShock Watch
build.oneLiner: 一个软件价格变更页面，在续费前向预算负责人准确展示点数、额度和实际单位成本发生了什么变化；灵感来自 Fable 据称高达 150 倍的点数涨价。

signals: 据报告，Fable’s credits 贵了 150 倍，暴露出软件买家很难看清单位价格变化。
Inkling 发布了完整权重：总参数 9750 亿、激活参数 410 亿的多模态模型，并引发 205 条讨论，焦点集中在定制能力与企业成本压力。
Firefox in WebAssembly 在一次据称耗资 $25K 的实验后引发 86 条讨论，证明把桌面软件装进浏览器是可行的，只是成本依然很高。

en.lead: The glamorous story is a new 975-billion-parameter model. The sellable story is a five-comment complaint: Fable credits became 150 times more expensive, and the customer discovered the change by watching usage become unaffordable. A quiet price change can hurt a small team faster than a benchmark win can help it.

build.title: PriceShock Watch
build.oneLiner: a software-price change page that shows budget owners exactly what changed in credits, limits, and effective cost before renewal, prompted by Fable’s reported 150× credit increase.

signals: Fable’s credits were reported as 150 times more expensive, exposing how poorly software buyers see unit-price changes.
Inkling released full weights for a 975B-total, 41B-active multimodal model and drew 205 comments about customization and enterprise cost pressure.
Firefox in WebAssembly drew 86 comments after a reported $25K experiment, proving browser-contained desktop software is possible but still costly.
